About Me

Hi, I’m Rawnok — a passionate Game Developer from Bangladesh specializing in Unreal Engine 4 & 5 and Unity. I’ve been learning and developing games since 2022 and am currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science. I develop stylized gameplay systems, AI mechanics, character Blueprints, Unreal Engine C++ systems, advanced animation systems, physics-based gameplay mechanics, vehicle and cockpit systems, UI/UX solutions, and engaging interactive experiences. In addition to Unreal Engine development, I also create games in Unity using clean, optimized, and scalable C# code, with a strong focus on performance, maintainability, and smooth player experiences. Currently, I’m focused on expanding my expertise in both Unreal Engine and Unity, with a particular emphasis on animation systems, artificial intelligence, multiplayer networking, gameplay architecture, Unreal Engine C++, and optimized C# development. I’m always eager to take on new challenges, collaborate with passionate teams, and contribute to innovative and meaningful projects within the game industry.
